versions.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Browser.

- Introduces a Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Allows fast, structured automation of web navigation, interaction, and data extraction via command line.
- Supports navigating, clicking, typing, filling forms, snapshots, screenshots, PDF/video recording, and advanced selectors.
- Includes features for state management, cookies, local storage, network interception, tabs, frames, and more.
- Provides flexible install via npm or from source.
